title: Change Drivers
description: Discovery's Change Drivers is about the stories of people working on the front lines to solve the most dire problems society faces. From plastic pollution to climate change, the multi-season series aims to tell the stories of those who are putting everything on the line to find solutions to some of our society's most dire problems and create lasting change.

content.about:
## The award-winning series about **people working on the front lines** to solve the most dire problems society faces.

'Change Drivers' inspires our viewers to reflect and **take action on pivotal issues affecting our planet** and airs on all the major Discovery and Warner Bros. channels.

content.heading: Christopher Raeburn
content.body:
Meet Christopher, a pioneer in sustainable fashion. He challenges us to see that waste is only waste when we fail to use our imagination, Learn more from Christopher on how fashion has the power to transform waste into beauty.

To learn more about Christopher' work, [visit his website.](https://www.raeburndesign.co.uk/?srsltid=AfmBOoq5LDpMNDQ6i04GiV-KCOAocFIU6yF2Touk_iY-1yB69uL1skpV)

content.heading: Douglas McMaster
content.body:
Meet Douglas, a pioneering chef, food waste activist, and founder of the world’s first zero-waste restaurant. From fermentation to full-system redesign, he shows us that if nature wastes nothing, why should we?

To learn more about Douglas' work, [visit his website.](https://www.douglasmcmaster.com/)

content.heading: Melati Wijsen
content.body:
Meet Melati, founder of the educational platform Youthtopia. She has been empowering people to create positive change ever since she was 12 years old. Now she invites us all to join her.

To learn more about Melati's work, visit [Youthtopia's website](https://www.youthtopia.world/).

content.heading: Paul Hilton
content.body:
Meet Paul, a prolific conservation photojournalist and wildlife crime consultant. Paul has spent the past twenty years traveling the globe documenting crimes against our planet, from the shark fin trade to illegal wildlife smuggling and the palm oil industry.

To learn more about Paul's work, visit his [website](https://www.paulhiltonphoto.com/).

content.heading: Rachel Ikemeh
content.body:
Meet Rachel, one of the most prominent conservationists in Nigeria. She has actively been in conservation for the past 15 years and has won a Whitley award in 2020 for her work in the extremely dangerous and challenging environment of the Niger Delta in southern Nigeria.

To learn more about Rachel's work, visit the SW/Niger Delta Forest Project [website](https://www.swnigerdeltaforestproject.org.ng/).

content.heading: Merijn Tinga
content.body:
Meet Merijn, also known as 'The Plastic Soup Surfer'. He advocates for us to transform our throwaway culture and demands a higher responsibility when it comes to how we use and discard plastics.

To learn more about Merijn's work, visit his [website](https://www.plasticsoupsurfer.org/).

content.heading: Šimon Michalčík
content.body:
Meet Šimon, the managing director of Plant-for-the-Planet  Czech Republic. He highlights the importance of ecosystem restoration and how we have the space to grow a trillion more trees in the world.

To learn more about Simon's work, visit Plant-for-the-Planet's [website](https://www.plant-for-the-planet.org/).

content.heading: Emily Penn
content.body:
Ocean advocate and skipper Emily is back for her second venture, this time championing the fight against microplastics. As an expectant mother for the second time, she's voicing her concerns about household plastic use, particularly with kids in the picture.

To learn more about Emily's work, visit her [website](https://www.emilypenn.com/).

content.heading: Andri Magnason
content.body:
Meet Andri, an Icelandic author. His mission is to spread awareness about the urgency of protecting glaciers and is inspired by his grandparents' testimony to acknowledge that we know what is happening and understand what needs to be done.

To learn more about Andri's work, visit his [website](https://andrimagnason.com/).

content.heading: Sagarika Sriram
content.body:
Meet Sagarika, a young Eco Activist who has become a powerful environmentalist voice in the Middle East. She was only 11 years old when she created her ‘Kids for a Better World’ website, a digital platform that has since than connected a global, young community of nearly 100,000 like-minded peers who want to learn how they, too, can fight climate change.

To learn more about Sagarika's work, visit her [website](https://www.k4bworld.com/11-year-old-dubai-resident-team-waste-warriors-spread-recycling-message/sagarika-sriram/).

content.heading: Emily Penn
content.body:
Meet Emily, a skipper and ocean advocate dedicated to studying environmental challenges in the most remote parts of our planet.  Emily and her team constantly test the water to determine how much plastic it contains, but also where this comes from and the chemical toxic pollution linked to plastic pollution.

To learn more about Emily's work, visit her [website](https://www.emilypenn.com/).
